title_sq: Shitet apartament 3+1+2 te Blloku i Ambasadave!

title_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale in the Embassy Block!
description_en: Apartment 3+1+2 in the Embassy Block, near the Chinese embassy. The apartment is part of an existing 3-story building, on the 3rd floor of the residence. The apartment has a regular layout and spacious spaces, the apartment is organized with the main entrance in the corridor where the distribution is made in the living room separated from the kitchen area, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. It has a mortgaged surface of 128 m2. The area where it is located is surrounded by low buildings and is under study for new buildings, which makes it a very good investment opportunity. For more information and a visit to the property, please contact us!
